subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` deliberately fail at write time for any unresolved changed text-model reference, including configurations whose model catalog may only become available later at runtime?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes compatibility behavior at a public CLI/config boundary; source-level review alone cannot choose the product upgrade policy.

options.title: Adopt set-time validation
options.body: Approve the fail-closed contract after final-head proof shows configured providers, aliases, auth profiles, and fallback semantics match runtime behavior.

options.title: Preserve deferred resolution
options.body: Keep the current write behavior and improve `config validate` or runtime diagnostics instead if delayed provider discovery is a supported workflow.

recommendation.title: Adopt set-time validation
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed contract after final-head proof shows configured providers, aliases, auth profiles, and fallback semantics match runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current assignee authored the proposed model-validation contract and can route the final product decision to the responsible CLI/model owners.
